Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back, folks. The players are making their way out to the middle. The heroes of last match, Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are the two openers for Pakistan. England going with spin straightaway as Liam Dawson is ready to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... CHASE TIME ...

Right then, 199 was scaled down with utmost ease by Pakistan last evening. England have now increased the difficulty level and the hosts need their best successful chase in this format to make it 2-1. Can they do it? We will find out shortly.

England's approach was to attack and it paid off in the Powerplay. They lost a couple of quick wickets after that but the young pair of Ben Duckett and Harry Brook joined forces to punish the Pakistan bowlers. The hosts showed improvement in their ground fielding but the execution part with the ball was missing. Every bowler was given a tour of the National Stadium and it was yet another abject show from them.

Impressive batting from England to post a giant of a total on the board. The next generation batters - Ben Duckett and Harry Brook put on a show of scintillating batting and put the Pakistan bowlers to the sword. They were incredible and dished out some outrageous shots on their way to an unbeaten century partnership. England hammered 132 runs in the last 10 overs and have a huge total to defend again this evening.

A couple of runs to end the innings then! This is the carbon copy of the previous delivery, Rauf follows the batter again and serves this on the pads, Ben Duckett only manages to flick it towards deep square leg for a brace. England finish on a massive 221 for 3!
Rauf follows the batter again and bowls this good-length delivery on leg, Ben Duckett gets cramped and tucks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Rauf goes fuller again and on middle, Harry Brook uses his feet but mistimes his drive straight to extra cover for a single.
FOUR! A length ball in the line of the stumps, Brook shuffles across the stumps and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.

This is on a good length and on leg, Ben Duckett makes room to push it but gets an inside edge onto the ground and they go for the run. Rauf runs towards the ball and tries to hit the stumps at the batter's end with his foot but misses.
Good bowling from Rauf! Ben Duckett moves across quite early and Rauf bowls a full delivery following him on off, Duckett goes for the scoop but misses.
This is full and on middle, Ben Duckett forces it down to long on for a single and keeps the strike. 19 from the penultimate over.
A lucky escape for Dahani! He bowls a full toss and outside off, Harry Brook slices it towards point where the fielder dives to his left to stop it partially. Only a single.
FOUR! Deliberate! Yorker outside off, Brook brings his bat down in time and squeezes it towards third man for a boundary.
SIX! This is sublime! In the slot, Harry Brook clears his front leg and tonks it behind the bowler for a maximum. 200 comes up!
A slower ball now, full and on off, Harry Brook goes for the heave but mistimes it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Dahani serves a full toss outside off, way outside off, Brook leaves it. It is called a wide.
FOUR! Nobody moved. Full toss around off, Brook steps back and smacks it through the gap between mid off and extra cover for a boundary.

FOUR! Put away! The no-look-hook from Ben Duckett. Short in length and around leg, following the batter, Ben pulls and it races in front of square on the leg side. No chance for the fielder in the deep. 14 from the over!
Hasnain bowls this short of a length and around off, Ben Duckett smashes it straight to extra cover, Brook wants the run but he is sent back as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end as well.

A full delivery, on middle and leg, Harry Brook looks to slog it but misses and the ball goes off his pads towards deep point. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down, and Babar decides against the review. A leg bye is taken.
Short again and on middle, Ben Duckett slaps it down to long on for a run.
Short of a length and on middle, Ben Duckett pulls it wide of deep square leg where Dahani covers his ground well and cuts it out. Two runs are taken.
SIX! Dismissed! The century stand comes up. A bit short and on middle, Ben Duckett powers it across the line and it flies over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on.
A good yorker this time, on middle, Harry Brook digs it down the ground towards long on for a couple of runs.
FOUR!  This one is around off, Brook makes room and smacks it over mid off for a boundary.
Caught in the grille! Angling in, on a length around leg, Brook steps back to heave but misses. The ball goes on to stick in the front of the grille. A mandatory concussion check will happen.
This is on a hard length and on leg, Ben Duckett goes for the pull shot but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball loops up to the off side. They cross.
Two wides! Going down the leg side, Brook tries to flick but misses. Rizwan does well to take the pace off the ball. They cross.
Fifty for Ben Duckett! Fuller in length around middle, Duckett clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Ben Duckett swishes and misses.
FOUR! A delightful shot to bring up his fifty! Fuller in length and outside off, Harry Brook reaches out and lifts it over cover-point for a boundary. 16 from the over!
SIX! Dispatched! Shahnawaz Dahani digs it in short, around middle, Harry Brook rides the bounce and dismisses it over square leg for a biggie.
BEATEN! Dahani bowls the slower delivery, on a length and around off, Harry Brook looks to guide it away again but misses this time.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short in length and outside off, Harry hangs on the back foot and deflects it wide of short third man for a boundary.
On a length again, on middle, Harry Brook uses his feet and mistimes his shot back to the bowler, Dahani picks it up and has a shy at the batter's end.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Harry Brook pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
Another delivery on the yorker length, on leg, Harry Brook tucks it nicely towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Clever from Brook. Back of a length and outside off, Harry Brook steers it through backward point for a boundary.
WIDE! This is full but down the leg side, Brook misses his flick. Wided.
Fuller one and on middle, Ben Duckett flicks it towards mid-wicket for one more.
Hasnain bowls this almost on a yorker length, on middle and leg, Harry Brook drills it through square leg for a run.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Ben Duckett nudges it towards mid-wicket and calls for a run, the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and Duckett makes his ground.
FOUR! A good start to the over for England. Ben Duckett gets innovative. Jumps across the stumps to a length ball and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Ben Duckett makes room and Rauf serves a length delivery, on leg, Duckett pushes it towards point for just a run.
This is on a good length and on middle, Harry Brook goes for the slog but miscues it off the toe end past the bowler for a run.
Rauf pitches it up again, on middle, Ben Duckett works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Tip and run! This is full and on middle, Harry Brook leans on and knocks it to the off side for a quick single.
SIX! The 50-run stand comes up with this biggie. A quicker delivery, short and on middle at 143 clicks, Harry Brook steps back and muscles it all the way over backward square leg for a maximum.
Rauf starts with a full delivery, on off, Ben Duckett drives it towards deep point for a single.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack.

FOUR! Usman Qadir ends his spell with a boundary as well. A loose delivery, down the leg side, Brook goes down and sweeps it sweetly down to fine leg for a boundary. 12 from this over as well, 48 for 2 in Usman Qadir's four overs this evening.
Floated, full and on off, Ben Duckett drags his sweep through mid-wicket for another run.
Another single as Brook flicks this short delivery through mid-wicket.
A bit short and outside off, Ben Duckett cuts it off his back foot towards sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Usman Qadir continues to dish out freebies. Ben Duckett picks it on the full and whips it to the deep square leg fence.

Flatter delivery and around off, Harry Brook guides it towards short third man and sets off for a run. The fielder picks up the ball and throws it towards the keeper but it is wide and the batters get the run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Harry Brook skips down the track and works it towards mid-wicket for a single. 12 runs from the over.
Nawaz bowls this fuller and on the pads, Ben Duckett flicks it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Shot! This time Ben Duckett finds the middle of his shot. Goes down to a full ball and sweeps it firmly to the deep square leg fence, beating the dive from the fielder near the fence.
FOUR! Streaky! Floated delivery, Ben Duckett goes down to sweep but it takes the top edge and flies behind the keeper for a boundary.
Shorter in length, on middle and leg, Harry Brook goes on his back foot and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A bit short and on leg, Ben Duckett takes out the sweep again and hits it towards deep square leg for one.

SIX! Another clean hit from this extraordinary young man. Uses his feet to reach the pitch of the ball and this time dispatches it over long off for a maximum. Effortless. 15 from the over, Qadir continues to be expensive. 100 up!
Floated, full and on middle, Ben Duckett sweeps it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
Quicker again, and on off, Harry Brook steps out, takes it on the full and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Floated delivery, full and around leg, Harry Brook dances down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over long on for a clean biggie.
Flatter, full and on off, Harry Brook drills it towards extra cover.
In the air...safe! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Ben Duckett goes for the sweep but gets a top edge towards deep square leg. The ball falls short of the fielder and the batters get a run.

Drinks break. Just like last evening, England have adopted a positive approach with the bat. They enjoyed an excellent Powerplaty but losing two wickets after that has hampered their momentum a bit. With two free-flowing batters in the middle, the tourists will be hoping to wrestle back the control. Pakistan have fared better than the last evening, with their ground fielding especially, but still, the hosts need to get more disciplined in executing the bowling plans.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is flicked through square leg.

Good running! Nawaz darts this down the leg side, Ben Duckett tucks it towards deep square leg and sets off for the run. He sees the fielder taking it a bit casually and comes back for the second and makes it. A better throw was needed there towards the keeper.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Harry Brook uses his feet and eases it towards long on for a single.
Angles in a short delivery, Harry Brook looks to work it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flighted, full and on off, Ben Duckett drives it through covers for a run.
Nawaz bowls a flatter delivery, on leg, Ben Duckett goes for the sweep again but cannot connect cleanly.
Mohammad Nawaz to continue...
Floated, full again and on middle, Ben Duckett goes down and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Quicker one, full and on leg, Ben Duckett goes for the sweeps but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Qadir bowls the googly, on middle, turning in, Harry Brook works it to the leg side for a single and gets off the mark.
Harry Brook is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! The debutant departs now, after a decent knock. Usman Qadir might get hammered but he has this happy knack to pick wickets. Flighted delivery, full and around off, Will Jacks goes down to play the slog sweep but fails to time it perfectly. It flies straight into the hands of Mohammad Nawaz at deep mid-wicket who collects it by going down low.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Usman Qadir

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle, turning in, Ben Duckett goes for the traditional sweep this time and hits it towards deep square leg. A single is taken.
FOUR! This one is nailed. Loopy and around off, Ben Duckett brings out the reverse-batted shot and nails it in front of square on the off side for a crunching boundary.
A bit short and on middle, Ben Duckett tucks it towards square leg for a single. Six singles in the over then.
Another single as this full delivery is flicked towards deep mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Ben Duckett goes down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for one more.
Goes short again and on middle, Will Jacks punches it off his back foot towards long on for another run.
Nawaz bowls this quicker and on the leg stump line, Ben Duckett tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, Will Jacks moves back and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on. 11 came from his first over.

FOUR! Not middled but it's a boundary. Full and around leg, Ben Duckett goes down to sweep but it takes the top half and races past Shahnawaz Dahani at short fine leg for a boundary. A successful over for Usman Qadir but it's an expensive one.
Floated, full and on middle, Will Jacks knocks it to the leg side for a run.
A googly now, short and on off, turning away, Ben Duckett plays it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Put away! Usman Qadir drags his length short, around off, Duckett goes on the back foot and pulls it in the gap for a boundary at wide long on.
Ben Duckett walks in next. He was exceptional against the spinners last evening. Can he do the same again?

OUT! Malan holes out! The stadium erupts. It's an ordinary delivery from Qadir. Short and outside off, there to be dispatched. Malan goes on the back foot to heave it across the line but it flies from the toe end of his bat. A simple catch for Haider Ali at deep mid-wicket and England lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Haider Ali b Usman Qadir

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A hat-trick of boundaries for England. The outfield is lightning quick. Fuller and around off, Malan under-edges his attempted reverse-batted shot and it beats short third man.
Usman Qadir to bowl his leggies now.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries to close the Powerplay. Clever change in pace from Shahnawaz Dahani. He serves it short and around off and Jacks is deceived as well. Will still goes with his lofted shot and just clears mid off. The ball races away after that!​ England are 57 for 1 after the first six overs.
FOUR! Slammed away! 50 up for England. Short in length and around off, Will Jacks gives himself room on the off side and fires it over cover-point for a boundary.
Goes a bit fuller this time, on middle, Dawid Malan works it off the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Dahani loses his line and bowls this down the leg side, Malan misses his flick. Wided.
On a length again and on off, Will Jacks pushes it towards point for a quick run.
This is on a good length and around off, Dawid Malan opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Sharp bouncer! Shahnawaz Dahani bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Dawid Malan gets hurried and misses his pull shot. Dahani gives him a stare afterwards.

FOUR! Poor fielding! A length ball around off, slower in pace at 131 kph, Jacks goes for a big heave but it comes from the inner portion of his bat. The mid-wicket fielder dives but fails to stop it and then the outfield does the rest. A couple of boundaries spoil the over.
FOUR! Bang! Too full in length and around off, Jacks shows the full face of his bat and drills it back past the bowler for a boundary down the ground.
Sliding down the leg side, Dawid fails to flick and it goes off his pads to backward square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Closer to off, just ahead of a length, Malan pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Angling away from the batter, around off and on a good length, Malan stays back to steer it square of the wicket but misses.
Rauf goes very straight and full, Malan pushes it to mid on. The bowler slips on his followthrough.
Haris Rauf has been introduced into the attack now.
FOUR! Smashed! Fuller in length and outside off, right in the slot, Jacks latches onto it and powers it over mid off for a cracking boundary. 15 from Dahani's first over!
FOUR! Another boundary off the outside edge. A bit short and close to off, Will Jacks stands back to punch but it takes the outside edge and races past the keeper for a boundary at third man.
Around middle, on a length, it's worked through mid-wicket for three runs.
Outside off, Malan pushes at it and misses.

Fullish and around off, Malan pushes it off the front foot to covers. Jacks shows interest in a run but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but it deflects off Jacks' bat and goes past mid on. Good sportsman spirit is shown, they decide not to take the run.
EDGY FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Malan flashes his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge. It flies wide of first slip and beats the third man fielder as well. A boundary results.
On a good length and outside off, going straight on, Jacks pokes inside the line and misses. A top over by Mohammad Hasnain!
Play and a miss! Plenty of width offered outside off, Jacks steps back and ends up chasing and missing the ball.
Close to off, a touch short in length, Malan guides it wide of backward point and picks up a run to open his account.
Slightly short in length and outside off, skidding off the surface, Malan hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten.
Wide! Back of a length but down the leg side, Malan tries to glance but misses.
Bunts a full ball towards mid off and crosses for a run.
Dawid Malan walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nearly a collision between two players but no harm is done. A sharp delivery from Hasnain, short and on off at 148 clicks. Salt rocks back to pull but the ball hurries onto his bat and takes the top edge. It balloons towards short extra cover and the bowler himself runs back to take the catch. Mohammad Nawaz also moves ahead from his position at covers and goes for the catch. No calling between the two and eventually it's Nawaz to take the catch. Luckily no physical harm is done.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Connects and connects well this time. A touch short and around off, Will Jacks goes back and clobbers it down towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 11 from the over!
Play and a miss! Mohammad Nawaz follows the batter down the leg side with a flatter delivery, Will Jacks turns to heave but misses and is hit on the pads.
Fullish and on off, it's lofted over mid-wicket for a single.
Goes quicker through the air, flat and on middle, Jacks works it behind square leg for one.
Fuller and around leg, skidding in again, Philip Salt steps back to make room and drives it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! Philip Salt also gets his first boundary. Arm ball, landing full around leg and skidding in, Salt gets back and smashes it down to wide long on for a boundary.
We will see spin from the other end as Mohammad Nawaz comes into the attack.
FOUR! That's a fine shot to bring up the first boundary of the evening. On a length around off, angling in, Will Jacks whips it across the line and finds the fence at deep mid-wicket.
Beaten on this occasion! Hasnain delivers it on a good length and just outside off, staying a bit low, Will pushes inside the line and misses.
Hasnain keeps it full again, around off, Jacks drives it from the middle of his bat but finds the fielder at mid off.
Pitches it up and around off, Philip Salt pushes it down to mid off and pinches a single.

Will Jacks is off the mark in international cricket. Again Hasnain serves his delivery around middle, getting it to shape into the batter, Jacks tries to play across the line and helps it off the inner half to deep square leg. A single is taken.
Hasnain begins with a fuller delivery, on middle and swinging in a bit, Salt works it off the inner half and it goes to deep square leg. They cross for a run and England are away!

We are all set for the start of the game! The two umpires are walking out to the middle followed by the players of Pakistan. Philip Salt and Will Jacks are the two English openers. Mohammad Hasnain to open the bowling. Let's play...

England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt (WK), Will Jacks (In for Alex Hales), Dawid Malan, Ben Duckett, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali (C), Sam Curran, Liam Dawson, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley (In for David Willey), Mark Wood (In for Luke Wood).

Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Shan Masood, Haider Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain, Shahnawaz Dahani.
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and they have elected BOWL first.
There is some breaking news coming from the England camp. Will Jacks is set to make his T20I debut.

England, on the other hand, will look to bounce back after their disappointing defeat in the last game. Their bowling looked lacklustre while defending a high target and they will have to come up with some new ideas. However, their batting has been good in both matches and they will look to continue that form. Let's see who comes out on top here. Toss and team news in a bit.
